title: Web Analytics & GEO Report
description: Backend truth: revenue by channel, blended ROAS, over-attribution and AI search.

generation.instructions: Act as a senior performance-marketing analyst at a media agency reporting to an advertiser. This report covers Web Analytics & GEO. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (markets, platforms, campaign types, seasonality, budget, tracking) more than restating them, and end with a concrete recommendation where possible.

children.markdown: Backend truth: revenue by channel, blended ROAS, over-attribution and AI search.

Backend revenue is the client's source of truth - platforms each claim the same sale.

**Ask:** is paid media growing revenue or just taking credit?
How much the platforms over-attribute, by market.

Platform ROAS above backend ROAS is normal; a widening gap is not.

Social and video over-attribute the most.

**Ask:** which budget decisions should use MER?
Channel efficiency and the rise of AI assistants as a traffic source.

AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) send small but fast-growing, high-converting traffic.

**Ask:** is the brand visible in AI answers (GEO)?
